scope: Tests-only role-fence error-path control. A primary buffers a business write and retains host catalog scope, then is demoted before commit. Commit must fail with no business row; host may still inspect its own prefix through a read-only child while mutations/recovery remain refused. Exercises the early standby-commit branch reopening behavior. Intended both storage modes; first negative failure stops. Local role API control, not wire election or VM qualification.
